answer: An identity's total weight is the square of the summed square roots of the weights of its independent attestations, the way quadratic funding rewards broad support over a single deep pocket. Fifty clones fed from one source count once under the root, so a farm gains almost nothing, while genuine breadth from unrelated attesters adds up. Like a river collecting small streams on its way to a summit of rock painted with saffron light, weight only gathers from many separate sources.
